//: Runner config for scripts/upload-e2e.mts only. It exists because that script imports real server modules (the route handler, the auth guards, the Supabase service client), and those carry `import "server-only"` — a package Next.js aliases away at build time and that does not exist in node_modules. Mapping it to the same no-op shim vitest uses is what lets the script run the REAL code outside Next, which is the entire point of the script. Never extend the root tsconfig with this: `server-only` resolving to a no-op in the app's own typecheck would silently disarm the import boundary it enforces.
